The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core mathematical logic and implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.70 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.53s. While the logic is sound, future iterations should verify edge cases in weight distribution to ensure the 'weighted-risk' component remains robust under non-standard inputs.
